title: Residue-Driven Round-Trip Navigator Stage A Candidate Registry

pilot_activation.reason: Stage A forms one Worms-owned question and issues no cross-world return, placement, promotion or executable result.

protected_target.statement: At two naturally reached V4 movement prefixes, determine whether equality under one declared thin authority projection preserves the exact one-next-command continuation readout after route, actor, turn and support are held fixed.

candidate_set.selection_rule: Select one transition from target-relevant D2Q residue and the Worms protected family; familiarity, field adjacency and narrative appeal are not selection evidence.

candidates.reason: It joins D2Q's bounded command residue to the already registered MOVE/RETURN basin while keeping the authority-side target narrower than credible player response.
The one/four-cycle pair is a correlated sentinel, not fresh Stage B evidence or global necessity.
D2Q already bounds actor relevance to the matching-turn stratum and preserves the mismatch no-witness control.
Trace-to-carrier formation is a composition under a decoder/support contract, not a new primitive; public formation is underdetermined.
WPV4-TIME-01 is not authorized and simulation tick time is not player time.
WPV4-PUBLIC-01 requires a separate Lane 4 environment, observation, timing, consent and data contract.

fixed_frame.horizon: One declared next command after each prefix; no tick advancement.

fixed_frame.oracle_input_boundary: Authority-readable source state may verify reachability and target output; case IDs, expected verdicts, selected-pair labels and reviewer knowledge may not enter projection or selection keys.

witness_interface.N_W: Unsearched routes, player perception, time, aim/fire, alternative policies/seeds and stronger continuation targets.

realization_query.negative_witness_condition: A preregistered exhaustive finite search finds no eligible holdout pair, or every apparent split disappears when target, route, horizon, support and oracle boundary are held fixed.
